dct_description_sm: The rectangular-shaped title of the cartouche is surrounded by natives, birds, sheep and a chameleon. Map Iincludes islands near Madagascar. The sea is decorated with several ships and two compass roses with rhumb lines.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997. Map 0336, p. 385.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0336.
